packets.atomic_claim: Directed information-flow estimates in FRANK should preserve and test an explicit conditioning set because common temporal drivers can create apparent directed flow.
packets.falsifier: Conditioning plausible global/body/goal/workspace drivers never materially changes directed-flow interpretation across preregistered H1 episodes.

packets.atomic_claim: Pairwise emergence/readout graphs can miss XOR-like higher-order causal mechanisms; multivariate decomposition plus matched lesion/rescue is required for higher-order candidates.
packets.falsifier: Pairwise reduction reproduces all selected FRANK higher-order intervention responses within preregistered tolerance.

packets.atomic_claim: PEID-style interventional synergy and observational PID/PED should be stored as distinct measurement families because maximum-entropy interventions alter source correlation/redundancy structure.
packets.verification_requirement: Benchmark observational vs interventional decompositions on shared fixtures
packets.falsifier: Observational decomposition adds no discriminating information across a representative intervention benchmark after PEID receipts are available.

packets.atomic_claim: Learned macro-emergence searches require holdout/OOD anti-Goodhart evaluation because optimizing effective information admits trivial or overfit coarse-grainings without constraints.
packets.verification_requirement: Search/evaluation split for any learned macrostate estimator
packets.falsifier: No optimism or trivialization gap under preregistered held-out contexts and intervention families.
